card.title: PlayStation 4 diagnostic flowchart based on LED status and screen output

claims.statement: If the PS4 shows no power light upon pressing the power button, check standby voltages, SMPS power supply output, and the Southbridge boot sequence.
claims.evidence: The diagnostic flowchart routes no light symptoms to checking standby voltages, SMPS, and Southbridge boot sequence.
claims.quote: Press power button ... Check stand-by voltages ... SMPS Power supply good? ... Check boot sequence by Southbridge IC

claims.statement: If the PS4 powers down immediately after a beep, inspect power-on voltages.
claims.evidence: The diagnostic flowchart directs checking power-on voltages when the console turns off after a beep.
claims.quote: Press power button ... Turns off After a beep ... Check power on voltages

claims.statement: If the PS4 LED stays solid blue, inspect the RAM modules and the APU.
claims.evidence: A solid blue light (BLOD) maps to checking RAM and APU in the diagnostic diagram.
claims.quote: Is LED blue? ... Stays on ... Check RAM ... Check APU

claims.statement: If the PS4 shows a white LED but no image on screen, inspect the HDMI circuit, encoder IC, and sound IC.
claims.evidence: White light with missing picture directs troubleshooting to HDMI, sound, and encoder circuit elements.
claims.quote: Is LED white? ... Picture on screen? ... Check HDMI / Sound / Encoder

claims.statement: If screen display is working but there is no sound output, check the Southbridge IC.
claims.evidence: The diagnostic flowchart routes no sound issues under active display to the Southbridge IC.
claims.quote: Picture on screen? ... No sound ... Check Southbridge IC

procedure: Press the power button and observe the LED status and system response.
If no light turns on, check standby voltages, verify SMPS power output, and trace the Southbridge boot sequence.
If the console turns off after a beep, check all power-on rail voltages.
If the LED stays solid blue, inspect the APU and RAM modules for faults.
If the LED turns white with no display output, inspect the HDMI port, HDMI encoder IC, and audio circuit.
If display output is present but audio is missing, inspect the Southbridge IC.
card.caveats: This flowchart provides high-level diagnostic routing based on symptoms and requires component-level testing to locate the exact point of failure.
